title: Illustration use / Building and bicycle on white

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Use fewer motifs when the subject is focused so the illustration does not overwhelm supporting copy.
strategic_value: A yellow facade and bicycle can make a Helsinki text page distinctive while preserving a quiet reading surface.
demonstration: A black heading and two paragraphs sit at left on white; a large yellow building, signboard and bicycle fill the right.
practical_value: Choose a compact related motif group when the text should remain the main source of detail.

content_islands.name: Copy column
content_islands.spec: Align the heading and paragraphs on the left.

content_islands.name: Architectural group
content_islands.spec: Anchor the right side with the yellow facade and place bicycle and signboard below.

reference_purposes.Application: The slide pairs a text column with a limited building-and-bicycle group.
reference_purposes.Expression: Yellow illustration accents stand out against a predominantly white composition.
